Amit Malviya Removed as BJP IT Cell Chief; Deepak Maskey Appointed

Amit Malviya has been removed from his position as the head of the BJP's IT cell. Deepak Maskey has been appointed as the new head of the social media department. Malviya congratulated the new BJP office bearers, including Maskey. Reports suggest the removal may be linked to dissatisfaction from the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS). The specific reasons for Malviya's departure and Maskey's entry into the team are being described as an 'inside story'.
